properties.displayName: Contoso - Deploy diagnostic settings to the platform Log Analytics workspace
properties.description: Deploys diagnostic settings that stream resource logs to the platform management Log Analytics workspace. Add the diagnostic settings policy of a resource type to policyDefinitions to bring that resource type in scope.

metadata.description: Resource id of the Log Analytics workspace that receives the resource logs.
Enable or disable the execution of the policies in this initiative.

Diagnostic category group that is streamed. Only allLogs is allowed because virtual networks have no audit category group. Add audit back when a resource type that defines it is added to policyDefinitions.
Locations of the resources that stream to the workspace. A single entry * selects all locations. Assign the initiative once per region, each with the workspace of that region.
